people.name: Gog
people.line: A symbolic enemy of God's people in prophetic literature.

people.name: Meshech
people.line: A nation, descendant of Japheth; associated with Tubal

people.name: Tubal
people.line: A nation, descendant of Japheth, known for trading

translations.web: “You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.
translations.bsb: “As for you, O son of man, prophesy against Gog and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.
translations.kjv: Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:
translations.asv: And thou, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal:
